description.value:
Whether you were on Akiton during the Drift Crisis protests or you were inspired by the brave activists, you've become aware of how economic inequality accelerates disasters into humanitarian crises. You know that governments and megacorporations that rely on exploitation will inevitably be brought to justice, and you're willing to educate, prepare, and protect the people by any means necessary.

Choose two attribute boosts. One must be to Intelligence or Charisma, and one is a free attribute boost.

You're trained in the Crafting skill and the Legal Lore skill. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.feats.Item.Akiton Battery Hack] skill feat, even if you don't meet the prerequisites.
